Over an 8-minute window, Ironvale generated 4 final third entries and 4 shots with an xG of 0.57, driving momentum shift despite Redmond’s aggressive pressing strategy, as indicated by a momentum index of -0.603. Ironvale’s 61.5% possession and 78.0% pass accuracy in the last 10 minutes highlight their effective ball retention and progression under pressure, facilitated by the overload in defensive numbers (5-3-2) and transition mechanisms exploiting spaces behind Redmond’s high defensive line. The sequence leading to the goal, marked by persistence and escalating pressure through two earlier attempts by Lindqvist, underscores Ironvale’s capacity to sustain counter-attacks and break defensive lines despite a calculated pressing trigger from Redmond [#1500] [#1529] [#1537].
